description: Use this when the person wants their palimpalem website in another language as well, or wants to remove one. Requires palimpalem sign-in. action=list shows the languages; action=add translates every page by AI in the background (about one minute per page) and publishes it under /<code>/ with a language switch, and later changes are translated automatically; action=remove takes a language off. The original language stays the one that is edited. Languages: es, en, de, fr, it, pt, ca.

web.description: The website: its name, its palimpalem address or its own domain.
